comment: Great for complete beginners. Simple A but you do have to put work in with constant quizzes, homework, essays, tests, etc. Lots of vocab to memorise in your own time. Good balance between teaching in German and English with clear instructions. Have to be ready to participate and jump into the deep end with speaking German in pairs or groups often.

Arguably one of the easiest A's in all of UR; so much so it's a double edged sword. I'm confident you'll be able to actually speak German by the time you get your COM2, but if you want to be challenged, I'd look elsewhere. I once gave a slavic buddy one of her old homeworks, refused to give them the directions, and they still would've got a 100%.
Dr. Weist is a brilliant teacher and caring person! She is super knowledgeable on the German language and is always willing to help you.

Dr. Weist is a wonderful professor! Coming into this class with no prior German knowledge was difficult as she only speaks German from day 1, but she is great with hand-signals and other things so you are not completely lost. Also, no one ever feels embarrassed or anything if they get something wrong. I've learned so much.
Dr. Weist is a wonderful language professor! She explains concepts well and is easy to understand in German. You learn a lot in this class, but it's also not stressful.
Class can be hard with no prior German experience but is very helpful working towards the language requirement and learning German.

I take her german classes so I can't speak to other ones, but she is a great professor! She's very friendly, but she holds high standards for her classes. Her 314 class was a lot of fun but very front loaded w work and ultimately you put on a play so it's a nice way to get out of ur comfort zone. Always come prepared to class.

Dr. Weist is really nice; you can see that she cares about her students. She even gave up one class to take us out for a movie related to what we covered. Sometimes the readings are long and assignments may be strenuous. Very lenient grader; I don't think anyone got below a B-
A challenging course that makes you learn, if you are willing to put in the effort. Go to office hours and get extra help if you want to be successful.

Incredibly rude. Berates students who dont understand, especially if they reach out for clarification. Unnecessarily petty in emails and in person. Does not have respect for her students & their work and it shows. Recommend against highly. Is not understanding in the slightest, so if you have any problem with her your best chance is to drop.

Generally an alright professor. However, there are some glaring issues. Mainly, her expectations are not well communicated in most of her projects, and more often than not students were left in the dark about certain (very important) things. She also wants things to conform directly to her expectations, and any deviation is, in her eyes, incorrect.

Dr. Weist is a great person, and I believe a great German professor. That being said, this FYS has been one of the hardest classes I have taken at college thus far. It seems extremely hard and time consuming and our class is unsure why. Do not take this class if you are looking for an easy FYS, although the course was pretty interesting.

Great professor! She really cares about her students and wants them to do well. I've had her twice and since my first semester (she had just started teaching at Richmond) I've seen great improvement. Would 100% recommend her to anyone interested in taking German.
Best teacher in all of Richmond by far. its easy it just takes a ton of work but like its not super hard work just make sure you stay on top of it

She cares about every single one of her students. Definitely the best professor out of all of them this semester. Her teaching style is engaging and she grades quizzes and essays fairly. However, I feel she grades her tests with too much subjectivity. Overall she's a great professor. Would take again.

About to finish my first semester of German 101 with her and it is a difficult class but she is extremely helpful and grades fairly. The homework is easy but be aware of the weekly vocab quizzes. Looking forward to having her again. Would definitely recommend.

Caroline is a great professor. She will push you to your limits with papers and projects, but she's always available as a resource to guide you. She does assign a lot of work, but you'll really find yourself engaging with and understanding the material. If you're studying German or theater, do yourself a favor and take a class with her!

I was warned about Caroline's strictness before taking this class and she did not disappoint. While the class was a lot of work and sometimes made me nervous, Caroline's a great instructor and german theatre is her bread and butter. If I took another german class, I'd want her as she's very clear with expectations. Go to office hours.
